rule: Select art using original FRLG metatile/behavior metadata. Never infer or replace collision, elevation, encounter tables, event coordinates or warps from this catalog.

behaviorHints.MB_JUMP_SOUTH: ledge; preserve the original one-way jump direction
behaviorHints.MB_LADDER: warp ladder art only; the FRLG warp remains authoritative

sampling.groundPatternRule: A 32x32 ground texture spans 2x2 logical tiles. Crop using mapX/mapY modulo the texture width/height; do not squash the entire image into every 16x16 tile.
sampling.atlasRule: Draw only the atlasRect; the two-pixel gutters are transparent. Repeating UV shaders must use individual texture files or explicit atlas-rect wrapping.
sampling.spriteRule: Trees and rocks use native model UVs and their model dimensions. Texture dimensions alone do not define collision or visible footprint.

limits: This is a semantic art kit, not a drop-in one-to-one mapping for every FRLG metatile ID.
Map-specific decorations, furniture, roofs and warp tiles without an audited substitution must retain their original FRLG layer art.
Do not replace every solid obstacle with a tree: buildings, signs, ledges, shelves and water barriers have different meanings.
Do not paint whole opaque ground tiles above interactive actors or events. Keep FRLG under/over layer ordering.
Water frames are static source textures; this kit does not port the original runtime animation timing.
